title: The Palace Practices on Itself
hero_prompt: A fine classical lithograph, Escher-inflected but warmly hand-drawn: a loom weaving a thread that curves back to become part of the loom itself, a structure building itself in a closed feedback loop, while one bright thread reaches off the edge to touch a real object outside the loop. Nested self-reference, meticulous cross-hatching, ink on aged paper, a darker upper register, contemplative not clinical.
icon_prompt: A bold high-contrast square emblem in pure black and white: an ouroboros reimagined as a loop of woven threads and small tools feeding back into itself, one link opening outward. Sharp geometric printmaking silhouette, no gradients.
